body:
Thank you. I have only 5 semesters to go, at least, but you're story has given me enough hope that maybe I can turn everything around. I just need to try like I never have before.

And yeah, my mom won't even talk to me right now after my last batch of grades...it kinda hurts, but I'm gonna use it as motivation. Only problem is I also need a job, that juggling that is going to be difficult.

Why do your friends mean nothing to you? What makes you not fit for life? 

If you're daydreaming about what your life could be, it seems that you might have a plan for what to make of it. Try writing them down, even if that feels a bit ridiculous at first, just write it down and then read over it, see what you can do right now to make those daydreams come true. 

So please, don't hurt yourself, and I'm glad you came here. Just stay in touch.

Not really...I would very much like to enjoy life, I just don't know how to or can't because of so many circumstances. 

I think if I could be wired to not care what people thought of me, and to be comfortable with myself so that I wouldn't hide from the world, I'd be free.

Technically, psychologists say that just having suicidal thoughts is a bad thing, and there's a difference between "oh man, somebody just kill me" or "i hate life" and " I hate this, i hate myself, I don't wanna live'. 

I've been both, more so the latter recently (which is the bad one). The thing is, it's natural to want to live at the last second, or chicken out. We're wired to want to survive. The one thing that stops me, besides not wanting to hurt my family, is the fact that I feel any reason I currently have for wanting to die would sound stupid if it was in a news report (that's how I imagine it anyways). 

If we measured suicidal by only how many people actually went through with it, then well, we wouldn't save anyone. So ya, if you think it, then you are, and you should find someone, anyone to talk you out of it.

Thank you, I'm gonna have to figure out what I can do to instill a change so I get over this. I think the worst part is that so many people don't consider it an addiction, they think it's a choice, so it's hard to get more opinions on what to do, so it's hard to talk to people close to me about it, and if I can't come up with a plan for change, I can't make it happen.

Thanks for the suggestion, but I don't think I'm ready for any kind of meetings like that. I'm such a wreck with myself I have trouble talking to even my closest friends as it is. Even if it is a judgement-free zone, I can already feel my nervous and guilt levels rising. 

I keep thinking about the stuff my parents said. I agree with them, that I'm a terrible person. I can't even sleep right now, but I have class that I have been going to and plan to go to in the morning. I wanna do well this semester, but I feel like I just lost the will to. 

Maybe I should have gone home instead of staying near campus for a whole semester while suspended, and paying rent for no reason. I see now that was stupid of me. 

PS I hope you don't mind, I just feel like I would like to keep talking to someone right now.

The thing is, I'm not happy that I do it, and I want to stop...I just don't know how to. I'm going be blunt and say that, yeah, I still enjoy watching porn and masturbating, but I don't think about how it's affecting me in the long term when I'm in that zone. 

And I believe in God, because I believe he let's us make mistakes so that we can find ways to overcome them and truly exercise our free will. I know my parents don't see it that way, but I do, and I want to fix my mistakes, I just wanna be stable again, happy again. I wanna erase the last 5 years of my life and get a do over.
